close_reason: Inlined has_* booleans using is_some_and; removes 16 lines of setup
description: email.rs lines 1374-1396: four bool variables (has_body_structure, has_text_body, has_html_body, has_attachments) are each assigned on one line and consumed two lines below in a single if-gate. The pattern let has_x = obj_val.get('x').map(|v| !v.is_null()).unwrap_or(false); if has_x { … } is strictly longer and adds more indented lines than writing the condition inline: if obj_val.get('bodyStructure').is_some_and(|v| !v.is_null()) { … }. The booleans name what they do ('has body structure') rather than what the code is deciding ('body structure was supplied by the client'). Inlining removes the indirection and 16 lines of setup code without any readability loss.
title: build_email_from_create: has_* booleans add indirection with no clarity gain
